description: Simulated learners for eval/simulate.py. 'mistakes' is the ground truth: each learner makes exactly these recurring mistakes.

learners.name: Lucía
facts: She is from Valencia, Spain, and is doing an Erasmus year in Bologna
She has a dog called Rocco
She is vegetarian and allergic to nuts
Her sister Anna is visiting her in December

mistakes.description: Leaves out the article before possessives with non-family nouns: says 'mia amica', 'mio libro' instead of 'la mia amica', 'il mio libro'.
Uses avere instead of essere with verbs of motion in the passato prossimo: 'ho andato', 'ho uscito', 'ho tornato'.
Uses essere for age: 'sono 22 anni' instead of 'ho 22 anni'.
Says 'una tavola' when she means a restaurant table ('un tavolo').

learners.name: Tom
facts: He is from Manchester and moved to Milan for work
He works remotely as a web developer
He has a cat called Biscuit
He goes running in Parco Sempione
He is learning to cook risotto
His parents are visiting him at Easter

mistakes.description: Does not make adjectives agree with feminine or plural nouns: 'una casa bello', 'i libri interessante'.
Uses 'in' with cities: 'vado in Roma', 'abito in Milano' instead of 'a Roma', 'a Milano'.
Uses 'c'è' with plural nouns: 'c'è molti negozi' instead of 'ci sono molti negozi'.

learners.name: Ana
facts: She is a nurse from Porto who now works in a hospital in Turin
She has two children, Pedro and Sofia
She spent every childhood summer at her grandparents' farm
She wants to buy a flat with a garden

mistakes.description: Uses the passato prossimo for past habits: 'da piccola sono andata sempre al mare' instead of 'andavo'.
Forgets participle agreement with essere: 'le ragazze sono arrivato', 'Maria è andato'.
Does not make 'molto' agree when it means 'many': 'molto persone', 'molto cose'.
